name: Dave McCormick

issue_poll.name: Franklin & Marshall College Poll, Oct 9–20, 2024
issue_poll.note: Averaged shares from two questions: most important problem facing PA and most important issue in presidential vote. Energy and environment merged. 'Government, politicians' and candidate-trait answers left out as untestable; civil liberties (tied at 9th) dropped as too vague.

issues.note: H.R.1 created a temporary deduction for tip income rather than full elimination.

issues.position: Would not vote for a federal abortion ban; leave to states
issues.note: No Senate floor vote on a national abortion ban this term.

issues.position: Finish the border wall; hire more Border Patrol agents
issues.note: H.R.1 funded wall construction and Border Patrol hiring.

issues.position: Extend the 2017 tax cuts; keep the SALT deduction cap
issues.note: H.R.1 made the 2017 cuts permanent; it kept a SALT cap but raised it.
No Senate floor vote on new gun regulations this term.

issues.position: Pass the SAVE Act to bar noncitizen voting
Expand oil and gas production; speed permits and LNG exports
issues.note: H.R.1 mandated new oil and gas lease sales.

issues.position: Expand school choice; end federal DEI funding
issues.note: H.R.1 created a federal tax credit for scholarship-granting organizations.
